offers_products.reason: Sells fitness equipment to franchisees, a main segment alongside franchising and corporate-owned clubs.

offers_services.reason: Gym memberships at franchised and corporate clubs; franchising royalties and services are the core business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual members buy gym memberships at Planet Fitness clubs.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Franchisees buy franchises and fitness equipment, a main buyer group.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly membership dues and franchisee royalties recur on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-cost monthly gym memberships are cheap and resilient; franchise royalties follow stable member dues.

big_ticket.reason: Members pay small monthly fees; royalties are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for gym facilities, equipment and brand, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual members and independent franchisees, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly franchised, so franchisees fund clubs and equipment; the company itself stays asset-light.

notes: Mostly franchisor; revenue from franchisee royalties, fees and equipment sales, plus corporate-owned clubs.
